summary: Added run_pvp_battle to sdk/actions/catalog.py (runBattleEndToEnd, not idempotent, ship observed precondition, trophy-change postcondition), optional evidence_probe/evidence hooks on ActionSpec, and battle evidence tiers derived from replaced step response objects (stale responses do not count; dummy battle id 0 is not recorded; client_reported_outcome_trusted is always false). ActionRunner probes before the call and journals evidence on every attempted path, including exceptions and failed after-snapshots. GameplayEvent has an optional, redacted evidence mapping; lines without it read back empty. runBattleEndToEnd and run.py are unchanged. 15 new tests in tests/test_pvp_battle_action.py; catalog id test updated; docs updated with the tiers and the trophy-observation gap.

contract_status_changes.before: Battles ran only through run.py with success taken from runBattleEndToEnd returning True if any step succeeded
contract_status_changes.after: run_pvp_battle is a catalog action whose outcome needs an observed trophy change, with per-call evidence tiers journaled as data

residual_risks: No verified read-only method returns current trophies, so with ClientSnapshotProvider every battle outcome is unknown until a trophy read is verified against a live response.
A trophy change during the window could come from a defense rather than the attack.
